description: project-os v0.7 id:activation-codex. Written to .codex/hooks.json by `project-os init`. Only `description` and `hooks` are accepted at the top level: any other key makes Codex load zero hooks. Trust is a hash over THIS entry (command, timeout, matcher, path), not over the shim bytes; changing this entry needs a human to re-trust it in /hooks, changing activate.mjs does not.
